note: Adds the reversed/Molt layer to all 14 Quills (Signal) cards. uprightMeaning aliases each card's coreMeaning; the reversed + molt blocks are additive. Quills stays strictly symbolic — thorns, broken antennas, quill-shaped feathers, wind, storm — never wounds, blood, ropes, or nooses, even in the darker reversed readings. Quills reverse toward renewal/relief more than the other suits, so the dark pips (3, 8, 9, 10) lean into release and dawn rather than worse harm.
accentMoltRule: warm+inward/deficiency -> drained ash; any+shadow/renewal -> oil-slick iridescent; cool+blocked -> frost-dimmed

reversed.meaning: Clarity soured — clouded judgment, confusion, the cutting truth misused to wound an argument; force without direction, a breakthrough that cuts the wrong way.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode swings wild: the clarity-sharpen effect hits indiscriminately — bigger edge, but it sharpens enemy plays too.

molt.featherState: the raised signal-quill notched and splitting, two loose feathers torn off in the gale
molt.lighting: cold underlight off the glass spire, the gleam gone hard and false
molt.borderState: wind-and-quill filigree frayed loose at the apex
molt.moltGlyph: single shed signal-quill in the cartouche

reversed.meaning: The stalemate breaks the wrong way — indecision collapsing into overload, too much information forcing a hasty choice; the blindfold torn off to a flood of conflicting truths.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode unlocks the standoff: both locked crew cards act at once, but the choice resolves randomly under the overload.

molt.featherState: crest feathers flattened and shedding, the even wings now uneven and ragged
molt.lighting: flat cold underlight, the closed eyes wrenched open
molt.borderState: the balanced wind filigree slipped off-true and fraying
molt.moltGlyph: single shed crest feather in the cartouche

reversed.meaning: Sorrow releasing — the thorns drawing back, forgiveness and recovery, the painful truth finally grieved and let go; the storm rain thinning to clear air.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode heals: instead of pinning a crew card, it lifts an existing sorrow/setback and restores the crew card a step.

molt.featherState: the thorn-caught feather working free, fresh pin-feathers coming in beneath
molt.lighting: cold rim-light warming at the edges as the driving rain breaks
molt.borderState: the thorn-and-quill filigree loosening, three thorns slipping their grip
molt.moltGlyph: single freed feather lifting from the cartouche

reversed.meaning: The rest ending — waking up, stirring back to action after stillness; or its shadow, restlessness and burnout, unable to settle, recovery refused.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode rouses early: the resting crew card returns this turn instead of next, but comes back jittery and at reduced guard.

molt.featherState: sheathed signal-quills shaken loose, roost-cloak feathers scruffed and lifting
molt.lighting: cold uplight rising in the belfry, the quiet dark thinning
molt.borderState: the still wind filigree unsettling, fraying back into motion
molt.moltGlyph: single shed feather lifting from the cartouche

reversed.meaning: The hollow win set down — reconciliation, making amends, the rivals turning back to talk; or its shadow, resentment kept burning and the conflict refusing to end.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode reconciles: instead of seizing spoils at a cost, it returns taken resources to mend encounter position and restore an ally.

molt.featherState: the swept-up trophy feathers slipping from its grip, its own plumage shedding mid-sweep
molt.lighting: cold underlight off the ledge, the harsh win-glare gone soft
molt.borderState: the quill filigree unravelling, the trophy-sash motif coming loose
molt.moltGlyph: single shed feather drifting from the cartouche

cards.uprightMeaning: Transition, moving on, calmer waters ahead

reversed.meaning: The crossing stalled — stuck mid-water, unable to move on, baggage carried into calmer sky; the gale at their backs refusing to ease, the bright shore never nearing.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode strands the move: the relocate effect halts halfway, the crew card caught between zones and resetting nothing until freed.

molt.featherState: the formation breaking up, trailing birds shedding flight feathers into the chop
molt.lighting: cold flat overcast, the promised clearing dimmed back to grey
molt.borderState: the wave-and-wind filigree jammed, fraying mid-crossing
molt.moltGlyph: single shed flight feather in the cartouche

reversed.meaning: The scheme exposed — coming clean, getting caught and owning it, returning the bundle; or its shadow, the deception driven deeper underground, cunning turned on the self.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode confesses: the steal/skim reverses — returns skimmed resources for goodwill, or, soured, slips them away from your own side.

molt.featherState: the bundled signal-quills spilling from under the wing, the sneak-wrap snagged and shedding
molt.lighting: cold exposing underlight catching the backward glance
molt.borderState: the muffled wind filigree torn loose, the furtive line frayed open
molt.moltGlyph: single dropped feather in the cartouche

reversed.meaning: Stepping through the open gap — freeing oneself, self-acceptance, the wind-bound fear seen as a choice and released; or its shadow, retreating deeper into the antenna-ring and the self-imposed limit.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode breaks the bind early: the self-restricted crew card frees itself without the condition — or, soured, locks itself a turn longer.

molt.borderState: the antenna-and-wind filigree splitting wide where the gap stands

reversed.meaning: The dread easing — anxiety lifting toward hope, the sleepless night thinning to first light, fears named and shrinking; or its shadow, despair sinking deeper before the turn.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode reassures: instead of weakening a crew card with doubt, it clears an existing stress effect — or, soured, deepens it one more step.

molt.borderState: the storm-and-quill filigree unclenching, the worry-knot coming loose

cards.uprightMeaning: Rock bottom, ending that turns to renewal

reversed.meaning: The worst already over — recovery and rising, the dawn fully up, the staged ending behind and a stronger start ahead; only the long shadow of the night still lifting.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode is rebirth made early: the reset/rebirth capstone skips the low and seeds the fresh, stronger start straight away.

molt.featherState: the ten staged signal-quills toppling and clearing, fresh feathers breaking in as the bird rises
molt.lighting: the sunrise fully risen now, cold night underlight burning off the spires
molt.borderState: the wind-and-quill filigree shedding its frost, re-forming brighter

cards.uprightMeaning: Curiosity, sharp wit, an incoming message

reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode chatters: the scout/messenger draws a resource but reveals it to all players, the carried word leaking out.

reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode judges harshly: the discernment effect grows sharper but bites allies too, precise control at the cost of warmth.

reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode dictates: the command effect compels every Quills crew card, gaining raw control but eroding the crew's discipline resource.
